get.summary: Frame-exact sync state from FPP's MultiSync clock
get.description: Returns the current media or sequence position from FPP's native MultiSync clock, extrapolated with a steady_clock delta. Media and sequence sync are tracked separately; fresh media wins so the reported position always corresponds to the audio file being fetched. The PHP wrapper re-anchors the snapshot to its response time and returns master_seconds: the browser must add only its measured RTT/2 and must never subtract browser wall time from server wall time (that is clock skew, not latency). On players and remotes this requires MultiSync to be enabled (FPP Settings -> MultiSync); otherwise confidence is 'unresolved'. The native plugin also mirrors state to <mediadir>/plugindata/fpp-ListenLive/ll_sync.json. The legacy HTTP variant uses ?clock=1 to return the clock payload instead. The wrapper also returns a compact transport block from a cached fppd status read: listen.php uses it to auto-play when the page opens during a show, cut over exactly once on a track/sequence change, and go idle when the show ends. Timing still comes only from the native MultiSync position.

200.description: Sync state (always answerable; precision degrades to unresolved/stale rather than failing)

has_media.description: True when media is known and its position is non-negative.

seconds.description: Media/sequence position in seconds at the last sync packet.

extrapolated_seconds.description: Estimated current position in seconds at the server timestamp; -1 when no media or stale sync.

master_seconds.description: PHP wrapper: authoritative master position at server response time. The client adds RTT/2 only — never a wall-clock difference.

sync_age_ms.description: PHP wrapper: age of the sync snapshot at response time, in milliseconds.

file_type.description: 'media' for a media file, 'sequence' for an fseq. The PHP wrapper maps a sequence clock to the current_song audio for chunk fetching.

frames.description: Sequence frame number from the MultiSync packet; -1 for media.

packet_age_ms.description: Age of the last native sync packet in milliseconds; -1 when no media.

extrapolated.description: True when extrapolation was applied (last sync under 2 seconds old).

frame.description: Approximate frame number at the last sync position (44.1 kHz); -1 when no media.

last_media_half.description: Half-second tick of the last recorded media position, used for dedup.

monotonic_ms.description: Native steady_clock timestamp in milliseconds at the time of the response.

wall_ms.description: Native system_clock (wall) timestamp in milliseconds at the time of the response.

epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock reference in milliseconds used to anchor the clocks.

confidence.description: 'exact' when a recent sync packet and media are available, otherwise 'unresolved' (stale).

playlist_action.description: Most recent playlist action reported by MultiSync.

playlist_size.description: Number of items in the current playlist.

playlist_mono.description: Monotonic timestamp of the last playlist update, in milliseconds.

duration.description: Total media duration in seconds when known; may be added by the PHP wrapper or an updated native build.

has_duration.description: True when 'duration' is a trustworthy value for the current media.

server_monotonic_ms.description: PHP wrapper: server monotonic timestamp for round-trip compensation.

server_wall_ms.description: PHP wrapper: server wall timestamp for round-trip compensation.

sync_media.description: For a sequence, the native media/sequence name that produced the clock; the 'media' field is remapped to current_song for audio chunk fetching.

clock_source.description: Set to 'fppd-status' when the clock comes from the cached fppd status rather than native MultiSync.

transport.description: FPP transport state from one cached fppd status read, used for auto-play, track cutover and end-of-show detection. Never drives playback timing.

available.description: False when fppd status could not be read.

playing.description: True when FPP reports a show on air (paused/idle are false).

playlist_item.description: Current playlist item when exposed by the native plugin.

media_key.description: song|sequence|playlist|item; a change triggers exactly one cutover.

duration.description: Best available show duration, or null.

get.description: Returns the native plugin's steady_clock and system_clock readings, used to anchor Web Audio scheduling without media. The PHP wrapper (/api/plugin/fpp-ListenLive/clock) returns PHP clock values when the native route is unavailable. In the legacy HTTP variant this payload is returned by /ListenLive/sync?clock=1.

monotonic_ms.description: steady_clock time since epoch, in milliseconds.

wall_ms.description: system_clock (wall) time since epoch, in milliseconds.

epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock reference used to anchor the monotonic clock.

source.description: PHP wrapper only: 'php' when the native clock was unavailable.
